data.desc: GrabAGun Digital Holdings Inc. (NYSE: PEW) is a technology-driven commerce, distribution, and logistics company serving the firearms, ammunition, and outdoor industry. The Company operates across three complementary capabilities: digital retail through GrabAGun.com , operated by its wholly-owned subsidiary GrabAGun LLC ; wholesale distribution through its wholly-owned subsidiary Camfour LLC ; and manufacturer logistics and platform services through its wholly-owned subsidiary PEW Logistics LLC . GrabAGun.com is one of the nation's leading online firearms retailers, built on 16 years of proprietary technology spanning inventory and order management, pricing, demand forecasting, and regulatory compliance. PEW Logistics provides manufacturers with technology-enabled fulfillment, compliance, data, marketing, and direct-to-consumer capabilities.
